sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Use the main window to review local cluster status and open focused tools.

sections.title: Nodes
sections.body: This preview validates node records from the local config.json file at startup. The packaged Settings surface is currently read-only. Use Quit from the notification-area tray icon (the window close button only hides RCM), then rerun it with --configure to change supported local fields. Keep real topology out of source control.

sections.title: Remote Desktop
sections.body: Select a node or enter a remote address, optional Windows user name, and port. Check and connect performs only a bounded TCP port check; Connect anyway lets Windows diagnose a failed check. Passwords are entered only in the Windows sign-in window and are never accepted or stored by RCM. Clipboard sharing is opt-in; drives, generic and USB devices, cameras, microphones, printers, COM ports, smart cards, WebAuthn, and location redirection stay off. The remote PC normally needs Windows Pro or higher, Remote Desktop enabled, network reachability, and an allowed user. RCM does not configure the host. Unsigned RDP files may show a Windows warning or be blocked by policy.

sections.title: Cleanup
sections.body: Cleanup acts only on locally scanned, identity-bound candidates. Review the selection before applying it.

sections.title: Hide and exit
sections.body: Closing the main window hides it. Use Show to restore it or Quit for bounded graceful shutdown.

sections.title: Preview limits
sections.body: This preview composes personal outbound Remote Desktop but remains a local desktop preview. Other service buttons that report unavailable are not configured in this build; it is not a fleet agent or a replacement for an existing 1.x deployment.
